parentReportedMismatch: Prior baseline assumed one A192.0.2.80 and signedOriginalTTL300; actual independent baseline www-a has two A192.0.2.80/81 and signedOriginalTTL3600. ReceivedTTL300 remains legitimate.
adjustments: Bind exact numericFile/RRsetId/signatureId/public-key identity, signed metadata, canonical RDATA and signature-RDATA/signing-input hashes for all actually selected received/check/cache evidence.
Baseline positive answers and application addresses now include both .80 and .81; fixed changed-a mutation uses actual independent vector [.82,.81] with unchanged baseline signature.
Keep receivedTTL300/cache300 where intended, use signedOriginalTTL3600; short-original-ttl uses exact independently signedOriginalTTL60 and probe base+61.
Wildcard uses actual A192.0.2.90 and Labels2/OriginalTTL3600; CNAME/DNAME sibling A192.0.2.80 and private same-owner A198.51.100.80 retain their distinct exact signatures.

Conventional and NSEC3 no-wildcard, wildcard, ENT, parent noDS, Opt-Out, saltAA and iteration1 are independently signed separate zone variants; no baseline signature is relabeled over authored proof RDATA.
Parent explicit DS NODATA uses real example SOA minimum300/OriginalTTL3600, receivedTTL300; child SOA also actual minimum300.

DNSKEY Protocol2/Zone-clear cases authenticate actual signed candidate-containing DNSKEY sets; actual leaf mathematical signatures are valid but candidates ineligible. Missing-key uses actual signed KSK-only set.
Supported DS mismatch uses actual g2-only DNSKEY/leaf; stale private anchor uses exact CSK-g2 DNSKEY/leaf rather than unrelated private-g1 signature.

Expired/not-yet/wrong-clock/cache-expiry leaf cases have actual long-valid upper path inputs; no timeless or expired prerequisite cache is assumed. Not-yet uses real future-inception successor signature; wrong-clock changes validator clock only.
Unsupported alg250 and digest250 are separate actual parent-signed singleton snapshots, not an illegally merged RRset signed by singleton signatures.
